SessionOnVolume's comment says 'a tree or controller volume'; it is the issue's or the controller's.
expectVolume computed twice and the resume-on-volume predicate written twice; one launch method.
pool room counted in cpu and memory only while every pod now requests 6Gi ephemeral storage; harness-only.
deleteSandbox and deleteFenced are both fenced foreground deletes with two policies (wait vs keep-on-conflict); name the policies and share the call.

implementer/tester memory default 4Gi vs the tester's lane trend (go test summed RSS 1.6→2.5 GiB over the day's merges); under gVisor the pod's 15 GiB sum binds, so raising to 6Gi is a placement cost (19 GiB pod) rather than an enforcement change; the production check measures the real lanes.
